mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_config (user_uuid, model_name, temperature, max_tokens, system_prompt, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userUuid}, #{modelName}, #{temperature}, #{maxTokens}, #{systemPrompt}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_uuid, model_name, temperature, max_tokens, system_prompt, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_agent_config WHERE user_uuid = #{userUuid} LIMIT 1
